{{Top|leg}}
This '''house''' was a one-story building located on [[Aing-Tii homeworld|the homeworld]] of the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was built for the use of [[Jorj Car'das]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] visitor to the Aing-Tii. In [[43 ABY]], many years after Car'das left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], traveled to the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] to find the Aing-Tii, in hopes of learning more about [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

The Jedi were received by [[Tadar'Ro]] on a [[Unidentified moon (Kathol Rift)|moon]] in the Rift, and were then given instructions to the Aing-Tii [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Upon arriving, they were shown to this house, which was to be where they stayed during the day.

The house was small and one-story tall, with four walls, a roof, and a door. Inside was a mattress, two table, and shelves. The floor was covered by a rug woven with a native [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. The room was cluered with repair parts for [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], and [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]]. There were also several wooden statues, carved by Car'das.
